_doc: [late] Cradle Mode (post-game prestige, systems/cradle_mode.gd + systems/world_gen.gd). After the Cradle finale the ark can carry Lumi to a new world: a fresh planet seed with its own world type (biome mix), name and two modifiers. Starseeds (prestige currency, kept in the profile, not in a world save) are earned from a world's restoration and its Seed Ark waves: earned = floor(per_ark_wave * waves + per_bloom_milestone * milestones + per_sqrt_thriving * sqrt(thriving hexes) + cradle_bonus * cradle_returned + per_base_l5 * bases at level 5); a world pays only what it earned since it last banked (claimed). Heirlooms are permanent meta-upgrades bought with Starseeds: level n costs round(cost * cost_growth^n). Effects: stat (multiplies Economy.stat(stat) by 1 + per_level * level) or start (a starting kit for every new world: cubes / data / seeds / robots / research nodes). Modifiers multiply stats for that world only and may change the sky (night_speed: how fast nights pass) or world events (event_weight).

heirlooms.name: Green Thumb
heirlooms.desc: Plants grow 8% faster per level, on every world.

heirlooms.name: Deep Hopper
heirlooms.desc: Lumi's hopper holds 10% more per level.

heirlooms.name: Trader's Eye
heirlooms.desc: Bales sell for 10% more per level.

heirlooms.name: Seed Vault
heirlooms.desc: 8% more seeds per bloom per level; each new world starts with 40 seeds per level in the pod (ready for when Lumi finds that world's seed tin).

heirlooms.name: Head Start
heirlooms.desc: Each new world starts with 1,500 cubes per level.

heirlooms.name: Data Cache
heirlooms.desc: Each new world starts with 60 research Data per level.

heirlooms.name: Old Crew
heirlooms.desc: Robots wait at the landing site: a Scoopie at level 1, a Haul Bug at 2, another Scoopie at 3.

heirlooms.name: Archivist
heirlooms.desc: Research notes travel with Lumi: level 1 knows every first-tier node, level 2 the second tier too.

modifiers.name: Heavy Rain
modifiers.desc: Rain showers come four times as often and plants grow 15% faster.

modifiers.name: Long Nights
modifiers.desc: Nights last twice as long. The night shift pays: bales sell for 10% more.

modifiers.name: Rich Salvage
modifiers.desc: The junk here is better stuff: bales sell for 30% more, but the hopper fills 10% sooner.

modifiers.name: Thin Soil
modifiers.desc: Plants grow 15% slower, but every bloom gives 25% more seeds.

modifiers.name: Tailwinds
modifiers.desc: Steady winds: Lumi moves 10% faster and supply drops come twice as often.

modifiers.name: Wild Bloom
modifiers.desc: Wildflowers want to come back: 30% more seeds per bloom, more wildlife visits.

modifiers.name: Heavy Junk
modifiers.desc: Dense, heavy scrap: scooping is 10% slower, bales sell for 20% more.

world_types.name: Ice Moon
world_types.desc: Frozen most of the way to the equator; lakes under the ice.

world_types.name: Desert World
world_types.desc: Dunes and dry salt pans; the few lakes matter.

world_types.name: Ocean World
world_types.desc: Mostly sea, with towns on small islands and long coasts.

world_types.name: Marsh World
world_types.desc: Warm, wet and soft underfoot: fungal marsh everywhere.

world_types.name: Rust World
world_types.desc: Old industry from pole to pole: rustlands and sprawl.
